name: ABFER 14th Annual Conference (2027)
organizer: Asian Bureau of Finance and Economic Research (ABFER)
deadline_note: Call for Papers 2027 window 15 October 2026 to 15 January 2027; no deadline time or time zone stated. Paper selection by 15 February 2027; discussant selection by 1 March 2027; presenters/discussants notified by 15 March 2027; schedule completed by 15 March 2027.
submission_requirements: PDF via the online submission link; first three pages must include corresponding author name and email, all authors names, emails and affiliations, abstract and keywords; a paper may be submitted to multiple programs; if selected, at least one author must attend and present; no conference volume. In-scope programs: Labour Economics; Real Estate and Urban Economics (joint with IREUS); Tech, Digital Markets and AI (joint with GIFTS, SEA and SKBI)
registration_fee: Conference fees waived for presenters and discussants
membership_required: No membership requirement stated in the last call
notification_date: By 15 March 2027 (only selected presenters, discussants and panellists are notified)
journal: No conference volume; papers may be submitted elsewhere
